mail.why: You receive this email because you are a recipient of this scheduled report in {app}.

failed.subject: Report failed: {report}
failed.intro: The report {report} could not be made this time. It will be tried again at its next scheduled run; if this keeps happening, check its filters or ask an administrator.

report-runner.label: Scheduled reports
report-runner.description: Starts the scheduled reports that are due, each export as the report's owner, and mails the recipients when one ends.
